subject: Compact QBR + roadmap walk-through — request to compress and schedule dry run
messages:
From: Claire Park <claire@olivetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olive Tech eng-ops <eng-ops@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact QBR + roadmap walk-through — time crunch this week

Kimberly,

Thanks again for the partnership — our execs are only available for a single 60-minute block next week and asked that we compress the renewal QBR into an executive-friendly walk-through of product impact and the 2026 roadmap. We still want a short technical checkpoint for our infra team.

Two options that work for us (PST):
- Tue Aug 17, 11:00–12:00 (preferred)
- Wed Aug 18, 14:00–15:00 (backup)

Can you propose a condensed agenda and confirm whether Redwood can run a 30-min technical dry run with our engineers beforehand? If so, can that dry run be on Mon Aug 16, 10:00–10:30 PST? We also need an internal runbook so our SREs know what to expect.

Attendees we plan to have: Claire Park (Eng Sponsor), Miguel Santos (CTO), eng-ops@olivetech.com

Thanks — quick confirmation would be huge, we need to lock exec calendars by EOD Friday.

—Claire
Claire Park
Director, Platform Engineering
Olive Tech

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire@olivetech.com>
Cc: Olive Tech eng-ops <eng-ops@olivetech.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact QBR + roadmap walk-through — time crunch this week

Claire — really appreciate the heads-up and the clear constraints. We can absolutely run a compressed exec QBR plus a separate technical dry run. Draft plan below; attached: "2026-08-09_Compact-QBR-Agenda.pdf" (one-pager) and an initial dry run runbook "runbook_redwood_dryrun_v1.md".

Proposed structure (compressed):
- 0:00–0:05: Quick introductions + top renewal milestones (Kimberly)
- 0:05–0:20: Impact highlights + usage/cost trends (Priyom)
- 0:20–0:40: 2026 roadmap focus areas + rollout plan (Marcus)
- 0:40–0:55: Customer-specific ops and SLOs (technical owner)
- 0:55–1:00: Next steps & mutual action items

Tech dry run suggestion: Mon Aug 16, 10:00–10:30 PST — short run through of demo flows, network/firewall checklist, and recording permissions. Priyom and Marcus will own the demo and the runbook review.

If Tue Aug 17 11:00–12:00 is locked on your side, let's confirm that as the exec slot. We will send a calendar invite with a link to the dry run and the exec meeting, and include the runbook and a link to a short pre-QBR recording checklist for your SREs.

Quick asks for you to confirm in this thread:
1) Exec slot (Tue 8/17 11:00–12:00 or Wed 8/18 14:00–15:00)
2) Dry run acceptance (Mon 8/16 10:00–10:30 PST)
3) Any additional internal attendees we should expect for the tech segment

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Renewals — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Park <claire@olivetech.com>, Olive Tech eng-ops <eng-ops@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Runbook + dry run ownership (short)

Priyom / Marcus — quick internal note: Claire has asked to compress the renewal QBR into one 60-min exec slot (Tue 8/17 11–12 PST). They'd like a 30-min tech dry run Mon 8/16 at 10:00 PST. Please own the dry run and confirm the attached runbook is sufficient. Key check points:
- Demo flows: multi-tenant routing, fallback to smaller model variant (keep token counts low)
- Network checklist: ports, CIDR allowlist, MTU issues for on-prem customers
- Recording permission and transcript capture — confirm legal/compliance default is OK
- Fallback plan if demo requires more time: record short clips and post-run follow-up session

Can you confirm by EOD that you can take the dry run and comment in the runbook? If anything breaks the compressed agenda we should escalate to Kim.

Thanks — Kim

From: Claire Park <claire@olivetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olive Tech eng-ops <eng-ops@olivetech.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact QBR + roadmap walk-through — time crunch this week

Thanks, Kimberly — Tue Aug 17 11:00–12:00 PST is confirmed for exec QBR. Dry run on Mon Aug 16 10:00–10:30 PST also confirmed — Miguel (CTO) will join the run and eng-ops will have two SREs on the call.

We reviewed the agenda and the runbook quickly — looks good. A few quick requests before the dry run:
- Can you call out the exact demo datasets you will use? Our SREs want to validate resource/IO before the session.
- Please include an explicit step in the runbook that lists who will control failover during the demo (Redwood engineer vs Olive on-prem ops).
- We need the exec meeting link and calendar invites by EOD tomorrow so Miguel can clear the calendar.

We grant permission to record the exec QBR and the dry run for internal review. Please upload recordings to the shared folder and notify us when available.

Looking forward to it.

—Claire
